skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and role of marketing communications and integrate marketing communication tools.
Apply principles and processes to develop creative strategies and build communication messages.
Work collaboratively in groups to develop and evaluate integrated marketing communication plans.
Analyze consumer behavior and psychological characteristics to inform communication strategies.
Evaluate media options and develop media plans based on target audience and brand objectives.
Manage marketing communication activities and assess their effectiveness.
Critically analyze marketing communication plans and strategies.
Develop creative ideas and messages for marketing communications.
Demonstrate ethical and social responsibility in marketing communication decisions.
Conduct market research to inform marketing communication strategies.
